posts.author: Saci
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I am new both here and in the RPG making world as a creator, so nice to meet you! Recently, I've been thinking about how I could make the scenarios of my game more appealing. I find myself stuck thinking of how to transport my vision to the RPG-making world.
I guess I need some inspiration, so please recommend me RPG Maker games where there is a main focus on that part, or simply because you find it beautiful. And please, talk more about how you deal with it in your projects.

posts.author: Tai_MT
posts.body:
I'm not actually sure what you're requesting.  Judging by my post being the first one you're getting, I'm going to guess I'm not the only one.
Anyway, welcome to the forums, I hope you stay a while.
Without knowing what "scenarios" you're talking about as well as your "intended audience", I'm not even sure what to recommend you in terms of RPG Maker games.
If you're just looking for a list of RPG Maker games to play, you can find a bunch to try on these forums.  If you have some cash, you could find them on Steam by searching "RPG Maker".  If you just want my personal recommendation of "A good RPG Maker game that I've played", then I simply suggest "Final Fantasy Endless Nova" which was made on RPG Maker 2000.
Beyond that, I'm not sure what you're asking for.
Are you asking me how I deal with being stuck on my vision?  Are you asking me about how I make the gameplay "appealing"?
I'm not sure what you're looking for in terms of replies.  You will need to be a bit more specific on what you are looking for.
